title: Amy C NDE 3151
content: Hard to explain in written word for now. Gallbladder surgery botched, which lead to the surgeons ignoring the fact that I had bile backing up in my body cavity, which in turn was causing my organs to shut down one by one over a course of ten days. I ended up having over nineteen pounds of bile in my body cavity when they decided to do something, and at this point I was almost dead.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal Close to being brought back.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time stood still for a while then it began to speed up.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | Darkness | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Vision of the future | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control This is what I called the NASCAR of crappy during my experience, because every character flaw, inhibition, fear - pretty much everything crappy about me in life - was put on the table and I was forced to deal with it.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the NDE
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes It was a few months before I shared, mainly because I needed to make sense of it all myself. Their reaction at first was a blank stare then a look of 'she's crazy', and I hope to God they were influenced, but one for sure was, my thirteen year old son. He is a lot calmer and understands the world more now, I'm actually grateful.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Most of this is hard to explain with the written word because there is so much emotion attached to it, so I'm sorry if I'm vague but I'll try to find another way to explain it.
